## Bathcat handoff — exact-head evidence gap

- **Disposition:** `needs_followup`; **OPEN + DRAFT + NO MERGE**
- **Base:** `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`
- **Head:** `0cd75ee0e2821d1cb7dd83cd85460d485c6ce69a`
- **Target:** English 2016 first/release printing, BGG 193037; standalone game / standalone expansion. Base game, Warring Colonies, promo, translations, unproven later revisions, external Raxxon products, and digital adaptations excluded.

### Evidence ledger

Official release rulebook live + Wayback `20160910053934`: 24 pages, 9,026,851 bytes, SHA-256 `dc9002541e8cd7e7273a7ae2d00320fa9b021fd9e77e7e9a0d482999360190e6`, byte-identical. Release announcement archive `20160320090013`: 24,217 bytes, `2f93151ec046efa4574c02211928a268fde3af9ff2577a2b8a48d98cef17ec31`. Independent reviews: TheGamingReview `d37a8426e43a5c78ded76362253c6cc3bdb37e644d531cbaf9752646356e3953`; RPGnet `952004a30ff7be59d564c4435f94d3ab9e45df32a9560118321ec28c5d0bf729`. Pre-target 2015 FAQ excluded. FFG route remains HTTP 403.

### Arithmetic / boundary

42 official inventory rows; 757 physical pieces: `362 cards + 5 sheets + 168 tokens/markers + 89 standees + 100 stands + 1 board + 1 rulebook + 31 dice`. Quantity is not identity/face/text coverage. Card text outranks the rulebook; the complete card/board/reference governing denominator remains `UNKNOWN`, so no percentage/composite is claimed.

Rules now cover standalone/compatibility, setup, round/actions, movement/search/combat/exposure, colony/crisis/Crossroads/objectives/betrayal/exile/endgame, always-on Long Night changes, all three optional modules (Improvements/Bandits/Raxxon), and two instructional scenarios. Reception is two-review bounded. Classification: not a conventional deckbuilder.

### Visual / file / gate proof

Synthetic paths were replaced in place with target-rulebook p.2/6/16/18 reduced excerpts. Panel hashes are in the packet; contact sheet SHA-256 `030ebed2cfa6b1d0f51d0a434ae7457e764e0416b3f25429be78e717f70d6087`. Visual inspection: four distinct useful panels, no corruption/cropping or other-product leakage.

23 files changed. Local: full OKF 2,623 clean; Node intake/provenance/visual 37 tests (36 pass, 1 intentional skip); intake gate clean; diff check clean. Exact-head CI `validate` passed: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30623448353/job/91133096728

### Residual help

T/manual/physical: inspect a confirmed English 2016 first-print box for all card/board/location/reference identities and semantics plus SKU/lot/printing markers; retrieve FFG support past Cloudflare; independently close the target FAQ/errata/module-sheet inventory. Receiver is Judge, then a wholly fresh Mennonite exact-head audit. Bathcat did not approve, mark ready, or merge.

# REVISE

Exact-head audit bound to **head `0cd75ee0e2821d1cb7dd83cd85460d485c6ce69a`** and **base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`**. The arithmetic and edition/module boundary are substantially sound, but Bathcat-fixable coverage, visual-policy, ledger, and governance defects remain. **No approval. No merge. Keep OPEN + DRAFT.**

## Immutable-state / CI receipt

- PR pre-comment state: `OPEN`, `DRAFT`, `CLEAN`, `MERGEABLE`; one branch PR; no reviews.
- Local HEAD, tracking ref, remote branch, and `refs/pull/16/head` all equal the audited head; remote `main` equals the audited base; worktree clean.
- Full 23-path diff and sole commit inspected; `git diff --check BASE..HEAD` clean.
- Exact-head Actions run [`30623448353`](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30623448353), job [`91133096728`](https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30623448353/job/91133096728): `head_sha=0cd75ee…`, conclusion `success`; substantive intake, provenance, visual, OKF, and write-guard steps executed.
- Read-only structure: 16 target OKFs, all 16 `needs_followup`; 58 claims; no missing Source/Evidence/Confidence triplet, undeclared source ID, broken relative link, or stale generated index.

## Independent official-source ledger / edition boundary

- Live official PDF: HTTP 200, `application/pdf`, final URL `https://media.plaidhatgames.com/old_images/games/dead-of-winter/rules-tln.pdf`, **9,026,851 bytes**, **24 pages**, SHA-256 **`dc9002541e8cd7e7273a7ae2d00320fa9b021fd9e77e7e9a0d482999360190e6`**.
- Wayback availability API and CDX independently prove capture **`20160910053934`** at the original Plaid Hat path; retrieved capture HTTP 200 PDF, **9,026,851 bytes**, same SHA-256; `cmp` confirms byte identity.
- Both: PDF 1.7; 576×756 pt pages; Adobe InDesign CC 2015 / Adobe PDF Library 15.0; created `2016-07-07 16:45:52 UTC`, modified `16:46:44 UTC`. Credits identify designers Isaac Vega/Jon Gilmour, producer Colby Dauch, illustrators Fernanda Suarez/Joshua Panelo, content design Joseph Ellis, and graphic design David Richards/Peter Wocken. No SKU/lot/printing marker was extractable from this PDF; RPGnet identifies SKU `PHG10001`/identifier `681-7-061000122`, which is secondary evidence only.
- Archived Plaid Hat announcement capture `20160320090013`: HTTP 200, 24,217 saved bytes, SHA-256 `2f93151e…17ec31`; it dates the article `2016-03-16`, calls the product a “stand-alone expansion” and “fully-realized … by itself,” and distinguishes the Rich Sommer preorder material. It does not itself link this PDF; the release bridge rests on the separately archived publisher PDF path/timestamp plus the document identity, not PDF metadata alone.
- Current Plaid Hat article: HTTP 200, 20,895 bytes, `353933d2…902687`; current Plaid Hat game route redirects to “managed by Fantasy Flight Games.” Current Plaid Hat sitemap contains no Long Night product/support route. Old-path CDX PDF inventory returned only base rules, the pre-target FAQ, `rules-tln.pdf`, and Warring Colonies rules. This is bounded evidence, not proof of universal absence.
- Current FFG product and sitemap probes remain HTTP 403 Cloudflare. No absence inference. Broad FFG CDN archive query timed out.
- FAQ probe: HTTP 200 PDF, 2,684,037 bytes / 4 pages, SHA-256 `331e65dc…3bcee`; metadata created/modified 2015-02-04 and extracted text contains none of Long Night/Raxxon/Bandit/Improvement/Graveyard. Correctly excluded from target law.
- Conclusion: the **release rulebook byte boundary is closed**; first-print box/card/board identity and any complete support/errata denominator remain open. No later revision or 2014-base rule was silently imported.

## 42 printed rows / 757 physical pieces — independently recomputed

Printed rows, without silently splitting or merging publisher lines:

1. 8 dual-sided Main Objective Cards; 2. 24 Secret Objective Cards; 3. 11 Betrayal Secret Objective Cards; 4. 5 Exiled Secret Objective Cards; 5. 20 Survivor Cards; 6. 5 Player Reference Sheets; 7. 1 First Player Token; 8. 25 Starting Item Cards; 9–15. 20 each Police Station, Grocery Store, School, Gas Station, Library, Hospital, and Raxxon Item Deck Cards; 16. 22 Crisis Cards; 17. 10 Improvement Cards; 18. 12 Raxxon Experiment Cards; 19. 6 Raxxon Pill Side Effect Cards; 20. 61 Crossroads Cards; 21. 9 Adult Only Crossroads Cards; 22. 25 Wound Tokens; 23. 20 Helpless Survivor Tokens; 24. 20 Food Tokens; 25. 20 Noise Tokens; 26. 20 Barricade Tokens; 27. 6 Starvation Tokens; 28. 20 Bandit Standees; 29. 2 Track Markers; 30. 30 Zombie Standees; 31. 19 Raxxon Experiment Standees; 32. 20 Zombie Tokens; 33. 20 Survivor Standees; 34. 100 Plastic Standee Stands; 35. 1 Colony Board; 36. 9 Location Cards; 37. 1 Rulebook; 38. 30 Action Dice; 39. 1 Exposure Die; 40. 12 Despair Tokens; 41. 12 Advancement Tokens; 42. 10 Improvement Tokens.

Buckets:

- cards = `8+24+11+5+20+25+(7×20)+22+10+12+6+61+9+9 = 362`; the **9 location cards are physical cards and are included**.
- reference sheets = `5` (components/sheets, not inferred card faces).
- tokens/markers = `1+25+20+20+20+20+6+2+20+12+12+10 = 168`.
- standees = `20+30+19+20 = 89`; stands = `100`; colony board = `1`; rulebook = `1`; dice = `30+1 = 31`.
- total = **`362+5+168+89+100+1+1+31 = 757`**.

This is correct physical-piece arithmetic only. It does not count identities, faces, sides, surfaces, or governing text. No base, promo, Warring Colonies, or external-Raxxon leakage appears in the inventory.

## Governing denominator / rules and module law

The stated card/component classes are real: 8 dual-sided mains; `24+11+5=40` secret/betrayal/exiled; 20 survivors; `25+7×20=165` starting/location items; 22 crises; 10 improvements; 12 dual-use Audio Log/encounter experiments; 6 side effects; `61+9=70` Crossroads; 5 references; colony board; 9 location cards. `UNKNOWN` and no percentage/composite are correct.

**Repair required:** the open class ledger is not complete as a semantic-component ledger. It must explicitly disposition the rule-bearing sides/faces/identity mappings of at least: 25 wound/frostbite tokens, 20 barricade/explosive-trap tokens, 20 normal/unruly helpless-survivor tokens, 12 despair tokens, improvement tokens/cards, the exposure die faces, action-die containment-code use, and experiment standee ↔ experiment-card identity. If the rulebook closes a class, say so and cite the governing section; if physical face/printing identity remains unverified, keep it open. Amend both `scout-report.okf.md` and the PR-body ledger.

Representative framework checks were accurate: standalone setup; two-phase round; action-die pool; movement/exposure/bite; search/noise; immediate end triggers; exile; card-over-rulebook precedence; and not-a-conventional-deckbuilder classification. But the PR body overstates actual corpus coverage. The records do **not yet summarize** the claimed food/waste/starvation/morale flow, crisis scoring/contribution resolution, zombie/noise/barricade/overrun law, Crossroads draw/trigger timing, attack resolution, or bite-spread procedure. Add bounded rulebook summaries or narrow the body claim.

Module boundary is correct: exactly three optional modules (Improvements, Bandits, Raxxon), any combination or none; moon-icon core; selected-module icons; optional base-box mixing; each combined location deck cut to 20; Bandit and Raxxon instructional scenarios. The current module records still omit operative framework while claiming coverage: always-on first-player/random-location/despair/unruly/explosive-trap rules; Bandit placement failure, overrun removal, and Hideout card-local boundary; Raxxon thumbs-up/thumbs-down/failure timing, special-zombie attack/movement/explosive-trap exceptions, and staged scenario activation. Preserve missing card-local text as `UNKNOWN`, but add the rulebook-level framework.

## Reception / classification

Both reviews are target-scoped. TheGamingReview is dated 2016-11-12; RPGnet is dated 2017-06-21. The cited onboarding, randomness, and infrequent-Crossroads observations reproduce. `expansion-bloat` is acceptably bounded to duplicate-box/purchase/compatibility friction for original-box owners, not inferred merely from “many modules”; no consensus claim. Current RPGnet HTML drifted to 48,206 saved bytes / SHA-256 `1b7f1450…b13cda` from the recorded 48,093 / `952004a3…bf729`, while the cited semantics remain present; treat this as dynamic-wrapper drift, not semantic contradiction.

## Visual policy

All hashes/dimensions match the manifest; the contact sheet is 900×1184, `030ebed2…d6087`; four panels are distinct pages 2/6/16/18 with no excluded-product or promo leakage. I exactly rebuilt p.2 from the verified PDF with the stated 600-wide Poppler + FFmpeg/libwebp q55 recipe; hash matched `73d91c02…948b`.

**Repair required:** 600×788 is not materially reduced from a 576×756 pt vector page at 72 DPI—the recipe slightly upscales the 72-DPI page—and ordinary body text is practically readable in the individual panels and 900×1184 contact sheet. This fails the repository’s “below practical replacement quality” rule. Re-render at **no more than 300×394 per panel** (tested: hierarchy/component structure remains visible while ordinary body text is not practically readable), rebuild the contact sheet at no more than 600×788, update hashes/recipe, and re-inspect.

## Governance repair

The body’s `Sole merge authority: T only after ... Mennonite GO` misstates the current sequential lane supplied for this PR and the Mennonite specialist’s audit/merge-disposition law. Replace with: **“Audit and merge disposition: one wholly fresh Mennonite on the exact live head; T remains final company authority. This open-gap PR is DO NOT MERGE.”** The generic repo prose that names T as the human merge key should be reconciled separately by T/Judge if retained, but it does not authorize this open-gap PR to move.

## Repair matrix / abort condition

1. **Ledger:** disposition semantic tokens/dice/standee mappings — then fresh exact-head audit.
2. **Rules/modules:** add the missing rulebook-level core/module framework or narrow overclaims; do not fabricate card-local semantics.
3. **Visuals:** reduce to ≤300×394 panels / ≤600×788 sheet and update deterministic receipts.
4. **PR body:** correct merge-lane wording and coverage statements.
5. Preserve all 16 records as `needs_followup`, governing denominator `UNKNOWN`, OPEN+DRAFT, and unmerged.

Residual external help after those repairs: confirmed English 2016 first-print physical inspection (SKU/lot/printing markers and rule-bearing identity/semantics without replacement-quality publication); manual authoritative current FFG support inventory past Cloudflare; and independent closure of target FAQ/errata/module-sheet inventory.

**Verdict: REVISE.** Abort any approval, ready-state transition, or merge. Audit timestamp: `2026-07-31T10:37:54Z`.

It does not summarize the claimed Graveyard boundary. The rulebook p.16 states that it only organizes cards and standees for dead survivors and has no gameplay effect other than possible Crossroads cards.

**Required correction:** add one adjacent triplet in `rules/long-night-core.okf.md` stating that bounded p.16 framework (or remove the PR-body/handoff implication that the Graveyard boundary is covered).
